title: Kissed Yeasty French White Yam Macaron
description: A yeasty, pillowy French macaron featuring white yam and bonito shave, perfect for a solo dinner, this dish is high in protein and delicious, made with white yam and bonito shave for a unique flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour, yeast, and salt.
In a large bowl, whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Gradually add the granulated sugar to the egg whites and whip until combined.
Add the melted butter, water, and diced white yam to the egg mixture and whip until smooth.
Add the almond flour mixture to the egg mixture and whip until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a piping bag and pipe into small circles on the prepared baking sheet.
Sprinkle the bonito flakes on top of the macarons.
Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 200 degrees Fahrenheit and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
